title: The Eko Heritage Ball, Lagos (illustrated demo)

messages.text:
Hello, I’m Godmother. Tell me about the event you need to dress for: its name, a link, or a photo of the invitation. I’ll look up the dress code, colours and venue, find real pieces in local shops, try them on you, and make the final call easy.

You’re in demo mode, so this is a saved run: no photos leave your device and no credits are spent.

makeup.name: Bronze glow, berry lip
makeup.rationale: Warm undertones and deep skin carry metallic bronze beautifully. A berry lip ties back to the gold without fighting the emerald, and lasts under flash.

steps.instruction: Prep with a hydrating primer, then press foundation in thin layers from the centre of the face outwards. Keep it sheer on the cheeks so skin still reads as skin.
Sweep under the cheekbones toward the ear and blend upward with a damp sponge until no edge remains.
Pat bronze across the lid with a fingertip, deepen the outer corner with espresso, and blend up to the crease.
Tight-line the upper lashes and flick 5mm out, following the angle of your lower lash line.
Tap onto the high points of the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose. Less than you think; flash doubles it.
Line with a matching pencil, fill, blot on tissue, then apply a second coat. It will last through dinner.
